-- Avatares AI — Catalog Init HOTFIX v3
-- Fix: existing ingest_profiles may not have is_enabled.

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS avatar_catalog (
  avatar_id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  avatar TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  avatar_short TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  avatar_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'influencer',
  description TEXT NULL,
  notes TEXT NULL,
  is_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  disabled_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL,
  disabled_reason TEXT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scene_catalog (
  scene_id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  scene TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NULL,
  notes TEXT NULL,
  is_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  disabled_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL,
  disabled_reason TEXT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS asset_type_catalog (
  asset_type_id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  asset_type TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NULL,
  notes TEXT NULL,
  is_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  disabled_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL,
  disabled_reason TEXT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS generation_workflow_catalog (
  generation_workflow_id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  workflow TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NULL,
  notes TEXT NULL,
  is_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  disabled_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL,
  disabled_reason TEXT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS generation_model_catalog (
  generation_model_id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  model TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  provider TEXT NULL,
  description TEXT NULL,
  notes TEXT NULL,
  is_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  disabled_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL,
  disabled_reason TEXT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ingest_profiles (
  profile_id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  profile_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  avatar TEXT NOT NULL,
  avatar_short TEXT NOT NULL,
  scene TEXT NOT NULL,
  asset_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  workflow TEXT NOT NULL,
  model TEXT NOT NULL,
  seed BIGINT NULL,
  version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  auto_promote_latest BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  is_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  disabled_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL,
  disabled_reason TEXT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (avatar, scene, asset_type, workflow, model, version)
);

-- Existing table compatibility.
ALTER TABLE ingest_profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true;
ALTER TABLE ingest_profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS disabled_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL;
ALTER TABLE ingest_profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS disabled_reason TEXT NULL;

UPDATE ingest_profiles
SET is_enabled = true
WHERE is_enabled IS NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_avatar_catalog_enabled ON avatar_catalog (is_enabled, avatar);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_scene_catalog_enabled ON scene_catalog (is_enabled, scene);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_asset_type_catalog_enabled ON asset_type_catalog (is_enabled, asset_type);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_generation_workflow_catalog_enabled ON generation_workflow_catalog (is_enabled, workflow);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_generation_model_catalog_enabled ON generation_model_catalog (is_enabled, model);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ingest_profiles_active ON ingest_profiles (is_active, is_enabled);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ingest_profiles_avatar_scene ON ingest_profiles (avatar, scene, asset_type);

-- Normalize existing active profiles before unique index.
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    profile_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY
        CASE
          WHEN avatar = 'estefania-montealegre'
           AND scene = 'coffee-rain'
           AND asset_type = 'raw-image'
           AND workflow = 'flux-krea-dev'
           AND model = 'flux-krea-dev'
          THEN 0 ELSE 1
        END,
        updated_at DESC,
        created_at DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM ingest_profiles
  WHERE is_active = true
)
UPDATE ingest_profiles p
SET
  is_active = CASE WHEN r.rn = 1 THEN true ELSE false END,
  updated_at = now()
FROM ranked r
WHERE p.profile_id = r.profile_id;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_ingest_profiles_single_active
  ON ingest_profiles ((is_active))
  WHERE is_active = true;
